result: FDN colored damping now solves the first-order shelf at requested decay radii: H(r_dc)=g_dc and H(-r_ny)=g_ny, where r=g^(1/M) and M includes the full traversal. This includes IIR memory that unit-circle endpoint gains omitted. Neutral scalar attenuation and standalone ToneFilter gain API semantics remain. Prepared coefficient triples replace pending gain pairs, so queued room admission only copies targets/starts the existing ramp; construction/setters/reset perform design. Setter preparation does additional bounded work. Coefficients and recursive tone-filter state use f64, with f32 audio ports. The first f32 radial candidate improved the matrix but had maximum fast-endpoint relative error 89.1003 due to cancellation; its source/gates are retained as rejected evidence. Final 512 coefficient cases have maximum slow relative error 3.60e-16, fast relative error 7.79e-8, and slow-radius maximum transfer/target ratio 1.00000000000236 (original unit-circle design 2.87632). Full release 120 tests pass without ignores, including 80 neutral lossless-reference cases, staged room/predelay twins, reset/host and heap regressions; strict all-target QA Clippy and acoustic-quality QA pass. The unchanged 208-row corner runner improves from 16 to 12 failed rows: all four endpoint-envelope failures resolve (~0.270 -> 0.246 seconds), no passing row regresses, neutral observations remain exactly identical, and all rows are finite. Independent coverage/decision verifier preserves configurations and thresholds. Twelve sparse fit-quality failures remain and the gate still exits 1. Representative wall-clock QA initially failed maximum 12.858ms versus 10.667ms (median .391ms); preserve this failure. A balanced six-run comparison of copied baseline/candidate binaries then passed all runs: candidate medians .268/.270/.287ms versus baseline .267/.255/.251ms, with candidate maxima .738/6.454/1.875ms and baseline 8.410/5.715/.300ms. The comparison characterizes nominal cost and jitter, not worst-case device certification; source/binary hashes and isolated baseline lock repair are recorded. No echo geometry, latency, parameters, transition durations, EOF policy or tolerances change. Native/loaded deadline, listening/corpus, sparse fit and finite offline-tail requirements remain open; AAE is partial and overall completion remains 35/45.
limits: The 208-row fit gate still fails 12 rows; no full AAE completion claim.
An initial callback maximum missed the unchanged deadline; paired runs do not certify device or worst-load timing.
Radial constraints and static radius checks are analytical sampled design checks, not measured room/ear response or arbitrary nonlinear/modulated decay proof.
Finite offline-tail policy and external listening/corpus validation remain open.
